coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Building B
record.summary: WORKac's 8-story commercial building on Parcel B, with Breakthrough Properties assisting on the life-science real estate (SF YIMBY, 2022) and marketed as Class A office/life science after its June 2023 TCO. It houses the district's blackwater recycling plant and has since leased to the Golden State Warriors (71,000 sq ft, October 2024), Coinbase (150,000 sq ft, 2025) and Nvidia (45,000 sq ft, November 2025).

open_questions: Construction cost: not stated in anything read.
Groundbreaking date: only The Registry's paywalled June 22, 2021 headline; the Port's December 2021 update confirms piles were done that year.
Square footage: four different figures across sources (272,770 / 281,639 / 295,000 / 313,952). The figure in this record's map notes (258,994 office + 13,773 retail) matches none of them exactly.
Address: 1090 Dr. Maya Angelou Lane vs 1051 3rd St vs 1089 3rd St (DataSF Assessor roll). Not resolved.
Lease terms and rents for the Warriors, Coinbase and Nvidia: undisclosed in every report read.

Images: no 'before' photo is hosted (until 2020 the parcel was the Seawall Lot 337 surface parking lot) and no rendering is hosted because the architects' renderings are not openly licensed; they are reachable through the architect sources listed here.
When Nvidia's lease commences: The Real Deal (Nov 21, 2025) says only that it 'is slated to occupy 45,000 square feet'; no commencement date appears in any source read.

Loeb & Loeb's page describes a 150,000 sq ft Building B lease for 'a leading cryptocurrency company' without naming Coinbase in its text (the name appears only in the page URL); the Coinbase attribution rests on Commercial Property Executive (May 2025).

MNT Studio's Mission Rock page lists the location with the 'opening class schedule' live and 'final week of founding memberships'; it has not been confirmed that the studio is open. Grey's Florals' August 2026 opening inside MNT's space has not been confirmed either.

record.notes: Building B -- ~300,000 sf Class A office/life-science (258,994 sf office + 13,773 sf retail); TCO June 2023; tenants incl. Coinbase, Nvidia (45,000 sf, 'slated to occupy' per The Real Deal, Nov 2025); also houses the district's blackwater/non-potable water treatment plant (Port memo, Oct 2023; The Real Deal, Nov 2025; nibbi.com/projects/mission-rock-building-b). CORRECTED 2026-09-13: an earlier version of this record was matched to block/lot 8719001, a mistaken shape/position match (DataSF Parcels shows that lot record dropped on 2005-05-31 and lists no address for it). Re-identified from the Mission Rock Design Controls' Figure 1.1 (Land Use Plan) and Figure 6.2 (Height Plan), which place Block B south of Block A along 3rd St, and by address: 8719C003 is addressed 1089 3rd St in DataSF's Assessor roll and DBI permit rows (The Canyon, lot 8719B002, is 1011 3rd St in the same roll). The reading of the plan figures and the footprint size are Pier & Point's own.
